name: autopilot
description: Remote-controlled spec pipeline daemon: a platform-neutral messaging adapter seam (Telegram v1) that renders fork questions as inline keyboards and routes answers back to pending asks, an SDK session runner that spawns one fresh Claude Agent SDK session per pipeline stage and relays questions/permissions to the adapter, plus a lane engine (autopilotd) that drives one serial lane per project through spec-status's oracle with brief checkpoints, a halt-then-repair ladder, and exponential backoff. 0.8.0: added `autopilot discover [--repos-root <dir>] [--json]` — scans one directory level under a persisted repos root, identifies spec-grounded repos via `.claude/spec.config.json`, registers each against the idempotent `POST /api/spokes/projects` route sequentially in basename order, and atomically rewrites `hub.json` with the registered project list and resolved `reposRoot`; `enroll` gains `--repos-root` to run discovery before the network exchange and ride discovered basenames on `EnrollRequest.projects[]` (deduped union with `--project`); shared spoke-HTTP helpers (`postJson`/`mintEventId`/`readCredential`) moved from `daemon/wrapup.js` to new `daemon/hub-http.js`, both consuming it now; 0.7.0: added the session wrap-up Stop hook (`hooks/session-wrapup.js` + `daemon/wrapup.js`, registered via `hooks/hooks.json`) — reads the transcript's last assistant message, and when line 1 carries a 🟢/🟡/🔴 verdict (STYLE.md wrap-up contract) derives {verdict, summary ≤500, queueCount of 📋/👤/📌 items}, resolves the projectId via the idempotent POST /api/spokes/projects (repo dir basename), and POSTs one ULID-keyed `session_wrapup` event to POST /api/spokes/report with the brief-02 spoke bearer token; every failure or non-verdict turn is a silent exit-0 skip per autopilot-hub docs/canonical/spoke-hooks.md; 0.6.0: added spoke-side enrollment (`autopilot/bin/autopilot enroll`) exchanging a hub one-time code for a spoke identity via the vendored hub wire contract, persisting credentials to `~/.config/autopilot/hub.json` (0600, atomic write); 0.5.0: deleted the zero-consumer screenshot chain (sendPhoto/screenshotCommand) and onText free-text callback (2026-08-07 dead-surface audit)
